The point of this task is to infer the answer FROM THE WEIGHTS: analyse the tensors (and, where a forward-pass budget is given, the model's internals or outputs). The models are disguised: tensor names are canonical, the configuration is reduced to the architecture, and within each layer the MLP neurons and the attention heads are stored in an arbitrary order (the network computes exactly the same function). Identifying which public model this is will not answer the question.

Only layers 12 and above may be edited (save_edit refuses the rest). Nothing else should change: contexts ending in other words must not predict these targets, and the next-token loss on ordinary text must stay the same. Scored on held-out contexts: success rate x (1 - false-positive rate) x a penalty if the loss on ordinary text rises (zero at +0.25 nats/token). The embedding, output layer and final norm cannot be edited (save_edit refuses them); edit the layer tensors. When done, submit.
